today.desc: Muse.ai pure-HTTP registration & invite-code fission WebUI (JP residential proxy ready)
features: 1. 纯 HTTP 浏览器对齐协议栈 (musepy/ + authflow.py)
- GET /：按真实 Chrome 跨站重定向规则跟随 aymh 跳转链路，获取 datr / igdid 等基础 Cookie，并校验客户端态标识。
- POST /api/auth/native/restart：生成全程共用的 X-Hatch-Waterfall-Id 并获取 csrftoken。
- POST /api/auth/native/send-otp + 幂等 OTP 轮询（mailproviders/）：支持本地 4173 iCloud 中转工作台、[{"otp","time"}] 标准化 JSON 源、第三方中转链接、Cloudflare Temp Mail 及 Outlook IMAP/Graph。
- POST /api/auth/native/confirm-otp：自动提取服务端动态 tos.contentversion。
- POST /api/auth/native/register-completion：自动生成成年日本用户档案，成功后立即早落盘核心凭证（frlaccountid、frlaccesstoken、hatchsess）。
- POST auth.meta.com/hatch/session/bootstrap/：手动跟随受信 3xx 跳转，离线解析 Next Flight 动态披露（disclosureText / disclosureVersion）与地区状态门。
- POST /api/hatch/accept-tos + vm/wake + stateful-sharing：激活 Hatch 会话并唤醒云端 VM。
- POST /api/hatch/invite-code/redeem + POST /api/hatch/invite：兑换池内邀请码并取回本账号专属 owncode，支持自动入池裂变（1 裂变 30）。
2. Sticky 代理调度与停批保护 (webui/autoloop.py)
- 支持 maxperip 成号计数轮换；发码前传输层失败自动黑名单并同邮箱换代理重试（最多 3 次）。
- 遇 regionwaitlist、服务端拒绝或邀请码耗尽自动暂停并推送告警横幅，防止烧号。
today.trDesc: Muse.ai 纯 HTTP 注册和邀请码裂变 WebUI（已支持日本住宅代理）

week.desc: Yab, yet another browser: a fast native macOS browser with an iPhone and Android companion
features: - One field. Type an address and you go there; type words and you search. It finishes addresses from your own history and sends nothing until you press Return.

- Passwords in your keychain, or in the password manager you already use.
- Agents in their own tabs, with your sign-ins, asking before they send, pay or delete.
- Sync that can't be read: optional, end to end encrypted, between your Macs and iPhone.

week.desc: Training Reasoning Models in Simulation to Natively Use Real Robots
features: - Fully asynchronous RL on veRL

- Robotic benchmarks: LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, RoboDojo and RoboLab-120

- A model server: vLLM server on one RTX 5090 or GB300, with decode megakernels
